system.description:
Deal [3D + (Magic Power)] magical damage to the target. A secondary target within a range of [Target: Single / Range: 4 Sq.] from the initial target recovers [(Recovery) + (SRx4)]

An attack magic that shoots the enemy with the brilliance of a mirror created by concentrating the spirit and steals their vitality. The mirror does not lead to replacement. The vitality bitten off by the brilliance is transferred to allies.
